title: 1c-DR-r1: Layers 0 and 10 unreconciled with the primer's per-milestone criteria rule
description: Minor, check d. Citation (Decomposition, Layer 0): 'no fixture-based criterion — verified by tracker queries and tree state'; Layer 10: 'Manual by design... no fixture-based criterion'. The primer requires each milestone's acceptance criteria be a non-empty subset of the behavioral contracts plus a red-gate seed; no recorded ruling in the section states the supersession. Fix: state the reconciliation in the Decomposition intro — the per-milestone obligations bind build Layers 1-9; Layer 0 (operational, operator sequencing ruling) and Layer 10 (manual class of the verification architecture's three-class split) sit outside them by ratified contract rulings, the same contract-over-primer precedence as the derived-view ruling. Owner: solution-architect. Validator: documentation-reviewer.
